newsitem.title: USA: FDA approves Advanced Magnetics drug.
newsitem.headline: FDA approves Advanced Magnetics drug.

text.p: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted marketing approval for Feridex I.V., a drug used to detect liver lesions, one of the companies marketing the drug said Tuesday.
Advanced Magnetics Inc said it would receive a $5-million milestone payment from Berlex Laboratories Inc as a result of the approval. Belex is helping market the drug in the United States.
"Our first U.S. approval is a significant milestone in the history of the company," it said, adding that it expected to launch the drug in the next few months.
Feridex is the first organ-specific drug used with magnetic resonance imaging to be marketed in the United States, it said.
Advanced Magnetics said Feridex had already received market approval in Western Europe, under the brand name Endorem. It said its European partner, Guerbet SA from France, was marketing it.
Advanced Magnetics and Berlex Laboratories are pharmaceutical companies.
